parsed.rationale: Both `PlaylistDataSourceV2` (in `Shared/Playlist/Sources/Playlist/V2/PlaylistDataSourceV2.swift`, package `Playlist`) and `DefaultAuthNetworkClient` (in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Sources/MusicShareKit/Auth/AuthNetworkClient.swift`, package `MusicShareKit`) are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists and a `shared_field_count` of 1. The structural similarity is purely coincidental: one aliases a playlist data source concept and the other aliases an authenticated network client — these are unrelated domain concepts whose identical shape (a bare type alias with no fields) reflects the nature of type aliases in Swift rather than any meaningful shared abstraction. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated concerns across two distinct packages with no semantic overlap.
